notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped default-region attribute Time Regulation re-enable surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies queued timestamped Update/Reflect delivery across Time Regulation disable/re-enable with changed lookahead, Query Lookahead, supplied-empty source-region metadata, grant ordering, Request Retraction, and cleanup without asserting provider-specific behavior.
